explication: curl is both a command-line URL transfer tool and the libcurl engine it drives. A typical workflow parses command-line options, creates/configures an easy handle, schedules a transfer through the multi engine, resolves and connects to the target, negotiates security and protocol-specific authentication, then streams data to callbacks or local output. The tree documents broad protocol support; several protocol and backend links below are architectural, while exact internal call wiring is limited by the sampled excerpts.
